fresh_candidates.sql: SELECT t.task_uid FROM tasks t WHERE t.pool_id=? AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.enabled=1 AND t.completed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_profile_state ps WHERE ps.task_uid=t.task_uid AND ps.profile_id=?) ORDER BY t.task_id COLLATE BINARY,t.task_uid LIMIT 20

plan.detail: SEARCH ps USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_task_profile_state_1 (task_uid=? AND profile_id=?)

active_heads.sql: SELECT h.attempt_id FROM lease_heads h JOIN tasks t ON t.task_uid=h.task_uid AND t.latest_attempt_id=h.attempt_id AND t.lease_generation=h.lease_generation JOIN api_keys k ON k.id=h.issuing_key_id WHERE h.pool_id=? AND h.expires_at>? AND k.status!='hard_revoked'

plan.detail: SEARCH h USING INDEX heads_pool (pool_id=? AND expires_at>?)

import_identity.sql: SELECT t.task_uid FROM task_identifiers ti JOIN tasks t ON t.task_uid=ti.task_uid WHERE ti.pool_id=? AND ti.public_id IN(SELECT value FROM json_each(?))

plan.detail: SEARCH ti USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_task_identifiers_1 (pool_id=? AND public_id=?)
SEARCH t USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_tasks_1 (task_uid=?)

pending_chunk.sql: SELECT ordinal,task_uid FROM admin_operation_items WHERE operation_id=? AND status='pending' ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 50

plan.detail: SEARCH admin_operation_items USING INDEX operation_status (operation_id=? AND status=?)
